title: Imperative 5: Habit vs One Result (читай каждый день / прочитай эту статью)
titleRussian: Повелительное наклонение 5: привычка или один результат (читай каждый день / прочитай эту статью)
description: A command can be imperfective or perfective. Use the imperfective (читай каждый день) for a habit or process, and the perfective (прочитай эту статью) for one specific action you want finished.
descriptionRussian: Команда может быть несовершенного или совершенного вида. Несовершенный вид (читай каждый день) — для привычки или процесса; совершенный вид (прочитай эту статью) — для одного конкретного действия, которое нужно завершить.
intro: Aspect comes back, and commands are where it gets practical. Telling someone to read every day and telling someone to read this article are different verbs in Russian, because one is an ongoing habit and the other is a single job to finish. The cue word in the sentence usually decides for you. Read it before you pick the form.
rules: Use the imperfective imperative for a habit or a process. Cues: каждый день, всегда, часто, по утрам, долго, внимательно, медленно.
Use the perfective imperative for one specific action you want finished. Cues: эту, сейчас, быстро, до пятницы, к утру, за час.
The cue word in the sentence decides the aspect. Read it before you choose the form.
The verbs come in pairs that share one imperative rule, and the perfective usually adds a prefix: читай / прочитай, делай / сделай.
examples: Читай каждый день! (Read every day!) Habit cue каждый день, so the imperfective читай.
Прочитай эту статью! (Read this article!) One specific article, so the perfective прочитай.
Говори по-русски всегда! (Always speak Russian!) Habit cue всегда, so the imperfective говори.
Купи молоко! (Buy some milk!) One shopping action with a result, so the perfective купи.
Делай уроки внимательно! (Do your homework carefully!) Process cue внимательно, so the imperfective делай.
Сделай задание до пятницы! (Finish the assignment by Friday!) Deadline cue до пятницы, so the perfective сделай.

rows.label: Perfective
cells: one specific action you want finished

items.hint: Эту = one specific article you want finished. Which aspect?
items.explanation: Эту статью points to one specific article you want finished, so the perfective прочитай fits.

items.hint: Каждый день = a habit. Which aspect?
items.explanation: Каждый день is a habit cue, so the imperfective читай fits.

items.promptEnglish: Buy some milk at the store!
items.hint: One shopping trip; you want the milk to come home. Which aspect?
items.explanation: One shopping action with a clear result (the milk) signals the perfective купи.

items.hint: До пятницы is a deadline. Which aspect?
items.explanation: До пятницы sets a deadline, so you want one finished action and the perfective сделай fits.

items.hint: Всегда is a habit cue. Which aspect?
items.explanation: Всегда is a habit cue, so the imperfective говори fits.

blanks: _____ книгу за час! (Read the book through in an hour!)
_____ книгу каждый вечер! (Read a book every evening!)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: За час sets a short deadline for one finished reading, so the perfective прочитай fits the first sentence. Каждый вечер is a habit cue, so the imperfective читай fits the second. The same verb, opposite cues, opposite aspect.

errorCorrection.sentence: Читай эту статью к завтрашнему уроку.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Read this article by tomorrow's lesson.
errorCorrection.explanation: A specific object (эту статью) plus a deadline (к завтрашнему уроку) means one finished action, so the perfective прочитай fits. The imperfective читай asks for the process with no endpoint, which clashes with a deadline that wants the article finished. Читай would fit a habit like 'Читай каждый день'.

errorCorrection.sentence: Прочитай по-русски каждый день, и ты быстро выучишь язык.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Read in Russian every day, and you will learn the language quickly.
errorCorrection.explanation: Каждый день is a habit cue, and a repeated command takes the imperfective читай. The perfective прочитай wants one finished reading, which contradicts an action repeated every day. Прочитай would fit a one-time request like 'Прочитай эту статью'.

errorCorrection.sentence: Покупай хлеб в этом магазине по дороге домой сегодня.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Buy bread at this store on the way home today.
errorCorrection.explanation: One shopping action with a result (the bread, bought today on the way home) takes the perfective купи. The imperfective покупай means 'be in the habit of buying', a standing rule that does not match this one errand. Покупай would fit 'Покупай хлеб только здесь' as a general rule.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Do your homework slowly and carefully.
errorCorrection.explanation: Медленно and внимательно tell you HOW to do the action, so the focus is the process and the imperfective делай fits. The perfective сделай wants one finished result, which does not match a manner cue about how to work. Сделай would fit a deadline like 'Сделай уроки до ужина'.

minimalPairs.explanation: Каждый день is a habit cue, so the imperfective читай fits. Прочитай (perfective) would mean one finished reading, which contradicts every-day repetition.
Сейчас plus one specific window means one finished action (the window will be open), so the perfective открой fits. Открывай (imperfective) would suggest a habit, which сейчас contradicts.
До пятницы is a deadline, so you want one finished letter and the perfective напиши fits. Пиши (imperfective) would describe the process with no endpoint, which the deadline contradicts.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each command by its aspect.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Read every day! (habit cue каждый день, so the imperfective читай)
sentenceBuilding.hint: Каждый день is a habit cue. Use the imperfective form.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Read this article! (one specific article, so the perfective прочитай)
sentenceBuilding.hint: Эту статью is one specific object. Use the perfective form.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Buy milk now! (one action with a result, so the perfective купи)
sentenceBuilding.hint: Сейчас plus one shopping result. Use the perfective form.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Do your homework carefully! (process cue внимательно, so the imperfective делай)
sentenceBuilding.hint: Внимательно tells you HOW. Use the imperfective form.

reviewVocab.definition: read! Imperfective читай for a habit or process (каждый день), perfective прочитай for one specific reading you want finished (эту статью)
reviewVocab.example: Читай каждый день, но прочитай эту статью к уроку.

reviewVocab.definition: buy! Perfective купи for one shopping action with a result, imperfective покупай for a habit of buying
reviewVocab.example: Купи молоко сегодня; покупай хлеб только в этом магазине.

reviewVocab.definition: aspect cue: the word that decides the form. Каждый день, всегда, медленно pull to the imperfective; эту, сейчас, до пятницы pull to the perfective
reviewVocab.example: Сигнал «каждый день» тянет к имперфективу, а «эту статью» — к перфективу.
